IX, 9</cite> (<cite ref="Sotah 47a:18">47ᵃ</cite>) <he>משרבו הרוצחנין … חזרו לקרותו בן הרצ׳</he> (Y. ed. <he>בן הרוצח</he>, read: <he>הרוצחן</he>) when the assassins became numerous, the ceremony of breaking the neck of a heifer (v. <cite ref="P00097"><he>עֶגְלָה</he></cite>) was abolished; when El. b. Dinai and T. ben P. arose, the section (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 21:7">Deut. XXI, 7</cite>) was read; then they called him (every such assassin) son of a murderer; expl. Y. ib. 24ᵃ top <he>בריה קטולה</he> a murderous creature; <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 205:1">Sifré Deut. 205</cite> <he>חזרו לקרותם בן הרצחנים</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 923:17">Yalk. ib. 923</cite> <he>משרבו הרוצחין … בן הרוצחנין</he>.—Pl. <he>רַצְחָנִים</he>, <he>רַצְחָנִין</he>, <he>רוֹצְ׳</he>.
